data.gender_notes: Owaisi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Owaisi is a name derived from the Arabic word 'Awaisa', which means 'honorable', 'good', and 'pious'. This name is mentioned in the Hadith and Sunnah as the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Owaisi carries the meaning “Honorable, Good, Pious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Owaisi usually hope their child will grow to embody honorable, good, pious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
